qualifierLines: {**28 NY3d at 985} OPINION OF THE COURT

County Court correctly held that the applicable statute is CPLR 4518 (a), which was amended in 2002 (see L 2002, ch 136, § 1) to provide that an "electronic record . . . shall be admissible in a tangible exhibit that is a true and accurate representation of such electronic record" (CPLR 4518 [a]). The statute further provides that the court "may consider the {**28 NY3d at 986}method or manner by which the electronic record was stored, maintained or retrieved in determining whether the exhibit is a true and accurate representation of such electronic record," but "[a]ll other circumstances of the making of the memorandum or record . . . may be proved to affect its weight," and "shall not affect its admissibility" (id. [emphasis added]).
